biological_chain: Fig1 B-cell focus -> historical B-cell-related Yellow module -> all 492 technically eligible historical-Yellow genes -> training-contained elastic-net Cox -> frozen sparse four-gene identity

selection_rule.rule: Across all alpha/lambda paths, define the envelope as global-best inner C minus the SE of that global-best row; among nonzero rows inside the envelope choose fewest nonzero genes, then largest lambda, largest alpha, and highest inner C.

score_contract.direction: higher linear predictor denotes higher modeled hazard
score_contract.external_transport: within-cohort gene z score weighted by gamma_j = beta_j * TCGA_training_SD_j; no refit, sign flip, gene deletion, or outcome-guided preprocessing
score_contract.missing_gene_rule: Any missing locked gene prevents FULL-score classification; partial scores are exploratory only.

mandatory_claim_boundaries: Internal validation is conditional on the historical full-cohort Yellow membership and locked full-cohort VST realization; it is not end-to-end validation of WGCNA discovery.

The sparse rule was developed after observing the fixed21 result and in a project with historically visible external outcomes; it is transparent post-hoc redevelopment, not pristine prospective selection.
The patient-mean C is an ensemble-of-20-heldout-predictions estimand, not the performance of one future fitted model; repeat SD is descriptive, not a confidence interval.
The custom cross-alpha rule is not standard glmnet lambda.1se.
The four full-fit genes are a stable core, but outer selected model size varied from 1 to 107; do not claim the nested procedure usually selected exactly four genes.
Sparse4 was frozen for parsimony, core stability, manuscript logic and transport coverage, not because it outperformed fixed21 internally or externally.
External evidence is heterogeneous; neither of two FULL OS evaluations survived the transparent two-test BH correction; GSE159067 is PARTIAL 2/4 and exploratory only.

downstream_authorization.required_input: Only the bound MODEL_LOCK/SCORE_TABLE/COEFFICIENTS/TRAINING_SCALE artifacts may define the primary score.
prohibited: retuning genes, coefficients, alpha, lambda, direction or preprocessing from downstream results
reading the historical FINAL_IES_SCORE_TABLE.tsv as primary
hard-coded gene vectors or fallback coefficients in downstream runners
calling partial or proxy scores complete-model validation

bootstrap.allowed_role: secondary sensitivity or optimism evidence only
